head: fix/story-2-8-maintenance-registration
title: ci: register the 1.7 maintenance source publisher
body:
Register workflow_dispatch on the existing source publisher so GitHub can dispatch the reviewed 1.7.x maintenance branch. The existing main jobs retain their callback condition and qualification behavior.

Delivered under https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd/pull/1 (owner source 3c285357c9eadec74a3516d649c8197fe1719052). The single added trigger declaration preserves the current source, product tests and dependency pins.

Validation: canonical owner template/hash checks, 17 owner delivery/environment controls, and the owning locked commitlint policy. Producer source qualification and protected publication remain subsequent gates.
